mLocKeys.keySummary:
Meeps: Bard attracts lesser spirits that assist with his basic attacks to deal extra magic damage. When Bard has collected enough Chimes, his meeps will also deal damage in an area and slow enemies hit.

Chimes: Ancient chimes randomly appear for Bard to collect. These grant experience, restore mana, and provide out of combat Move Speed.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Bard attracts Chimes randomly around the map. When Bard moves near a Chime he collects it, gaining @TooltipMSPerStack@% Move Speed (stacking up to @MaxSpeedStacks@ times) while out of combat for @SpeedStackDuration@ seconds, @f1@ Experience, and restoring @TooltipManaRestore@% max Mana.

Bard attracts a Meep every @f5@ seconds (max: @f4@). Bard's Attacks consume a Meep to deal an additional @MeepDamageNoChime@ plus @DamagePerCheckpoint@ per @TooltipChimeDamageCheckpoint@ Chimes magic damage, plus additional effects based on Chimes collected.
mLocKeys.keyTooltipExtended:
{{Spell_BardPTooltip_D_nS_Tooltip}}

Meep spawn time and max both improve with number of Chimes.
At @ChimesForSlowUpgrade@ Chimes, Meeps also Slow by @f2@% for @SlowDuration@s.
At @ChimesForSplashDamageUpgrade@ Chimes, Meeps also hit in an area around and behind the enemy.
At @ChimesForSplashAreaUpgrade@ Chimes, the area is larger.
The Move Speed can stack up to @TooltipMSMax@%.
The Experience increases by 1 per minute after 5 minutes.

mLocKeys.keySummary: Bard fires a missile which will slow the first enemy struck, and continue onward. If it strikes a wall, it will stun the initial target; if it strikes another enemy, it will stun them both.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Bard fires an energy bolt, dealing @TotalDamage@ magic damage to the first two enemies hit. The first target hit is Slowed by @SlowAmountPercentage@% for @SlowDuration@s.

If the bolt hits a second enemy or a wall, any enemies hit are Stunned for @StunDuration@s.

<titleLeft>Cosmic Binding - Stun</titleLeft><mainText>This unit is stunned by Cosmic Binding hitting two targets or a wall.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>

mLocKeys.keySummary: Bard sends spirit energy arcing to a location, putting all champions, minions, monsters, and turrets hit into stasis for a brief time.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Bard hurls magical protective energy to an area, placing all units and structures hit into Stasis for @RStasisDuration@ seconds.

mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>Tempered Fate</titleLeft><mainText>This unit is invincible, but unable to act.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>

mLocKeys.keySummary: Reveals a Health shrine which powers up over a short time, disappearing after healing and speeding up the first ally that touches it.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Bard creates a Health shrine that grants @Calc_MoveSpeed@ Move Speed decaying over @MoveSpeed_Duration@ seconds and restores at least @InitialHeal@ Health to the first ally to enter. The shrine grows to restore @MaxHeal@ Health after existing for @ChargeupTime@ seconds.

Bard can have up to @MaxPacks@ shrines at once. If an enemy champion enters a shrine, it is destroyed.

This ability has @Ammo_Limit@ charges.

Current Active Shrines: @f1@ / @f2@

mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>Caretaker's Shrine Speed Boost</titleLeft><mainText>Visiting a Caretaker's Shrine has increased this unit's Move Speed.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>
